title: Fix Connector Match And File Description Types
description: Resolve TypeScript errors in compose/js/index.ts: findMatchingConnector used non-schema Connector.id; replace with guid matching. File entity lacks optional description on FileSchema but emoji constraint iterates kit.files with description. Run compose vitest and close when green.
summary: findMatchingConnector now matches connectors by name or guid (ConnectorSchema has no id). FileSchema includes optional description so composeDescriptionMissingEmojiConstraint compiles for kit files. Verified: compose/js vitest 155 passed, compose/ui vitest 232 passed.
